title: Lab 8 — RBAC: Roles, RoleBindings, ServiceAccounts
description: Build a read-only ServiceAccount with a namespaced Role, verify it with impersonation and with the pod's own token (HTTP 200 vs 403), then add a cluster-scoped permission.

steps.title: Step 1: Create a namespace and ServiceAccount
Step 3: Bind the Role to the ServiceAccount
Step 4: Test with kubectl auth can-i
Step 5: Test from inside a pod, with the real token
Step 7: Aggregated ClusterRoles, and clean up
